plan.reviewedRule: First CI for held worker and lifecycle repairs follows finite #1654 policy step.

findings: All seven trusted policy blobs match current main and both held repair heads. Neither repair requires #1654 runtime or policy behavior to execute source tests.

Source workflow runs opened/synchronize/reopened PRs without a draft predicate. Its source-gates concurrency group is the individual PR ref, so opening independent drafts does not replace the current release-head runs; hosted runner capacity remains shared.
The three changed lifecycle tests and two changed MP3 tests receive existing changed-test admission; no policy relaxation or new workflow is necessary.
The held paths do not change native qualification scripts, declarations or package source pins. Native execution is not started by source admission.

Current main adds five First Flight paths relative to the held base. MP3 is path-disjoint; lifecycle shares app only at the exact disjoint homeAvailable hunk. Lifecycle integration proposal92c48842 records the complete union and exact expected tree.
Lifecycle shares app with Missions/Worlds/Backup work, but those hunks are outside the repaired fixed-step input block. Full combined-source checks remain necessary before release.
The existing plan postponement is a scheduling decision, not a source or admission dependency. Starting source qualification is compatible with holding main release during P0 public observation.

Merging #1654 later changes the trusted policy digest. If P1 repairs remain unmerged then, their old-policy receipts cannot be used for release under the new policy; reconcile exact heads and obtain fresh receipts. No trusted exception is proposed.
recommendation: Permit normal fresh-main draft source admission of the two reviewed P1 repairs now. Keep every current release head unchanged, preserve the finite #1654 hold, and retain release/native holds. Do not confuse source-check completion with published or device qualification; explicitly plan any later policy revalidation.
minimalPlanAmendment: Source qualification for the reviewed P1 lifecycle and MP3 acquisition repairs may begin now on separate fresh-main drafts. Their release and native checks remain held through the P0 observation and exact-head gate review. They do not depend on #1654; if that policy change lands before their release, reconcile their heads and obtain fresh policy-bound receipts. The original-trace prerequisite still applies to heap/overhead adapter changes.
mutations: Evidence blob only; no refs, PRs, jobs, policy settings, local files or functional tests changed.
